headlines.text: It was 2020 when Omega & Page vs. The Lucha Brothers clashed for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.93 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. A tag team showcase on the same loaded card as Cody's steel cage spectacle ? the champions closed things out with their signature Buckshot Lariat/V-Trigger combo, setting up a Revolution rematch against the Young Bucks after a chaotic tag battle royal.
That Wednesday in 2025, Orange Cassidy vs. Roderick Strong met in a Number One Contender, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 7.05 ? a strong outing.

Looking back to 2020, when Wardlow didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event in a Steel Cage match against Cody, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.03 ? one of the better matches of the year. Wardlow's in-ring debut, thrown right into a steel cage ? Cody capped a chaotic match involving MJF and a stolen diamond ring by climbing to the top of the cage and hitting a moonsault to win, a jaw-dropping spot that fans still bring up
